tool_description: AutoMorph_measurement is a Docker-based tool for automatic vascular morphology measurement from retinal fundus images. It supports multiple measurable features such as fractal dimension (FD) and vessel density (VD) across different vessel types (binary, artery, vein).

AutoMorph_preprocess is a Docker-based tool for preprocessing retinal fundus images. It supports resizing and other image normalization steps to prepare data for downstream analysis such as segmentation or classification.

AutoMorph_quality is a Docker-based tool for automated quality control of retinal fundus images. It evaluates image quality based on softmax outputs and standard deviation, and filters images using user-defined thresholds.
AutoMorph_segmentation is a Docker-based tool for automatic segmentation of retinal structures, including vessels, arteries vs. veins, and optic disc & cup, from fundus images.
End-to-end Python pipeline that segments choroid region, vessels and fovea, then outputs choroidal thickness / area / vascular index maps from OCT B-scans.

TotalSegmentator is an open-source deep learning tool for automatic segmentation of over 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR images. It supports various tasks including organ volumetry, disease characterization, and surgical planning. The tool is available as a Python package, a 3D Slicer extension, and a web application.
3-D CNN (TensorFlow 2.8) for binary detection of reticular pseudodrusen (RPD) in spectral-domain OCT cubes.

DermLipDDX performs large-scale differential diagnosis for clinical skin images. Trained on the Derm1M with knowledge-enhanced vision–language pre-training (MAKE), it can return a single best diagnosis, the top-3, or the top-5 ranked skin-condition labels—covering hundreds of diseases.

Performs an NCBI Entrez EFetch to retrieve full records for given UIDs. Accepts list or comma-separated string, respects rate limits, and returns the raw response (JSON if available, otherwise XML or text).
Performs an NCBI Entrez ESearch to retrieve a list of UIDs matching the given query term in the specified database. Handles URL-encoding, rate-limiting (1 s delay), and returns parsed JSON.

Performs an NCBI Entrez ESummary to fetch summary metadata for one or more UIDs in the specified database. Handles both list and comma-separated string inputs, rate-limits calls, and returns parsed JSON.
HairRemoval eliminates hair artifacts from dermoscopic images via morphological filtering and inpainting. Optionally, it can output a binary hair mask.
Transfer-learning notebook (PyTorch) that fine-tunes VGG-16 on the popular Kermany OCT dataset (NORMAL, CNV, DME, DRUSEN).

Timm (PyTorch Image Models) is a comprehensive deep learning library providing state-of-the-art pre-trained computer vision models, training scripts, and inference utilities for researchers and practitioners.

Timm (PyTorch Image Models) is a comprehensive deep learning library providing state-of-the-art pre-trained computer vision models, training scripts, and inference utilities for researchers and practitioners.

MIRAGE-RETOUCH is a multimodal foundation model for retinal fluid segmentation in OCT images. It segments IRF (Intraretinal Fluid), SRF (Subretinal Fluid), and PED (Pigment Epithelial Detachment) lesions with high accuracy. The tool computes lesion areas and provides Dice scores when ground-truth masks are available.

DeepBrainNet is a deep learning model that predicts brain age from skull-stripped and aligned T1-weighted MRI scans. It uses a convolutional neural network trained on over 11,000 subjects from diverse populations.

This tool generates synthetic 3D brain MRI volumes using a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) trained on UK Biobank data. Generation is conditioned on demographic and anatomical attributes including gender, age, ventricular volume, and brain volume.

SynthSeg is a deep learning tool for fast, contrast-agnostic segmentation of brain MRI (and optionally CT) scans. It supports robust segmentation, cortical parcellation, automated QC, and volumetric analysis, all without requiring retraining.

This tool performs skull stripping on T1-weighted MRIs across the lifespan using atlas-guided priors and deep learning. It selects age-appropriate brain atlases based on the provided subject age and outputs brain masks for input MRIs.
UNet-based Keras/TensorFlow model that segments 8 retinal layers on single OCT B-scans; outputs multi-class mask.

OCTCube-M is a 3D multimodal optical coherence tomography foundation model for retinal and systemic diseases with cross-cohort and cross-device validation. It provides multi-task classification for 8 retinal diseases: AMD, DME, Glaucoma, DR, ERM, VD, CRV/AO, and RNV. The tool supports screening, classification, and disease prediction with confidence scores.

PanDermCLS is an open-source ViT-based model fine-tuned on the HAM10000 dermoscopy dataset for 7-class skin-lesion classification (akiec, bcc, bkl, df, mel, nv, vasc). It performs single-image inference and outputs the predicted label with class probabilities.

PanDermDDX provides differential diagnoses of 23 common skin conditions for a clinical skin image. By default it outputs a single best diagnosis. Use --top3ddx or --top5ddx to return the top-3 or top-5 ranked diseases with confidence scores.

PanDermMD is a binary classifier for melanoma detection. Given a dermoscopic image, it predicts whether the lesion is melanoma (positive) or benign (negative) and writes the result with confidence to a TXT file.

PanDermSeg is an open-source skin-lesion segmentation model (PanDerm backbone with UperNet decoder) fine-tuned on the ISIC2018 dermoscopy dataset. It takes a single dermoscopic image and outputs a binary mask (PNG) in which lesion pixels are labeled 1 and background pixels 0.

DermReg performs pair-wise registration of a pair of two dermoscopic follow-up images using AKAZE key-points and a RANSAC-estimated homography. It outputs the aligned (warped) follow-up image together with the transformation matrix.

DermRadiomic extracts handcrafted radiomic features from dermoscopic lesions using PyRadiomics. It requires an image–mask pair and can export a CSV of features plus an optional human-readable TXT summary. Users may choose any subset of the seven PyRadiomics feature classes or supply a YAML parameter file for advanced settings.
RETFound is an open-source deep learning tool that provides pretrained weights on various retinal imaging datasets for automatic classification of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) and Glaucoma.
RETFound_shanghai is an open-source deep learning tool that provides pretrained weights on various retinal imaging datasets for automatic classification of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) and Glaucoma.

retfound_de is an open-source deep learning tool that supports automatic classification of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), Glaucoma, and Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) using pretrained models on various datasets.
Ensemble CNN (DenseNet-169 + ResNet-50) for multi-class retinal disease classification on Kermany dataset; improves spatial-resolution learning.
Ultraclassifier is a medical ultrasound image classification tool leveraging ConvNeXt and CLIP architectures, supporting multi-class classification for various anatomical structures and pathologies.

ultradetector is a medical ultrasound image detection tool based on YOLOv11, supporting multiple organ and lesion detection tasks, including the identification and localization of structures such as the heart, breast, thyroid, carotid artery, and fetus.

ultrasegmentator is a medical ultrasound image segmentation tool that supports multiple segmentation tasks, including CAMUS_Left_Heart, Four_Chamber_Heart, Carotid_Artery, Thyroid_Nodule, Thyroid_Gland, Fetal_Head, Fetal_Abdomen, and Breast_Nodule.

Bone Fracture Detection is a binary image classification model based on google/siglip2-base-patch16-224, trained to detect fractures in bone X-ray images. It is designed for use in medical diagnostics, clinical triage, and radiology assistance systems. The model achieves 83.03% accuracy with precision of 86.33% for fractured bones and 80.20% for non-fractured bones.

TorchXrayVision is a comprehensive library for chest X-ray analysis providing pre-trained models for classification, segmentation, and autoencoders. It supports multiple chest X-ray datasets and provides tools for pathology detection, distribution shift analysis, and pathology mask generation. The library includes models trained on various datasets like NIH, CheXpert, MIMIC-CXR, and more.

Digital Eye for Mammography is a comprehensive toolkit and benchmark for mass detection and classification in mammograms. It provides multiple state-of-the-art models including ATSS, Cascade R-CNN, Deformable DETR, DETR, DoubleHead R-CNN, Dynamic R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, FCOS, RetinaNet, VarifocalNet, and YOLOv3, with support for model ensemble and breast segmentation preprocessing.

FactCheXcker CarinaNet is an AI-powered tool for automatic detection and localization of carina and endotracheal tube (ETT) positioning in chest X-rays. Part of the FactCheXcker framework designed to mitigate measurement hallucinations in radiology reports. The tool provides precise localization of ETT tips and carina with distance measurements for clinical positioning verification.

MAIRA-2 is a multimodal transformer designed for phrase grounding in chest X-rays. It can localize specific medical findings mentioned in text phrases by generating bounding boxes on radiographic images. The model combines RAD-DINO-MAIRA-2 image encoder with vicuna-7b-v1.5 language model to provide precise spatial localization of radiological findings.

ChestXRayAnatomySegmentation (CXAS) is a sophisticated tool for accurate fine-grained segmentation of human anatomy in chest radiographs. It uses volumetric pseudo-labeling techniques with CT projection to achieve detailed anatomical segmentation without manual annotation. The tool can segment 157 different anatomical structures and extract clinically relevant features like Cardio-Thoracic Ratio (CTR) and Spine-Center Distance (SCD).

Mammo-CLIP is a Vision Language Foundation Model that enhances data efficiency and robustness in mammography through zero-shot analysis. It provides state-of-the-art mammography analysis capabilities using vision-language understanding with customizable prompts for mass detection, malignancy assessment, breast density evaluation, and other mammographic features.

MedGemma Visual Question Answering system leverages the 4B multimodal Gemma 3 variant with SigLIP image encoder for answering complex medical questions about radiological images. Trained on diverse medical datasets including VQA-RAD, it provides expert-level responses to clinical queries about chest X-rays, dermatology, ophthalmology, and histopathology images.
